notes.title: New Game Announced - Echo Generation
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we excited to share our new game that was just announced in the Xbox Games Showcase.

[i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1072300/Echo_Generation]Echo Generation[/url][/i] is a turn-based adventure game about a gang of kids investigating supernatural events while battling monsters and mechs to save their small town.

[previewyoutube=-Gi-F7gYYUk;full][/previewyoutube]

Check out some early press coverage for [i]Echo Generation[/i] by [url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/echo-generation-is-a-new-turnbased-rpg-about-savin/1100-6480081/]GameSpot[/url], [url=https://www.engadget.com/echo-generation-xbox-series-x-180340213.html]Engadget[/url], [url=https://www.gameinformer.com/xbox-games-showcase/2020/07/23/echo-generation-shows-off-turn-based-town-adventure]GameInformer[/url], [url=https://hardcoregamer.com/2020/07/23/echo-generation-announced-during-xbox-pre-show/383588/]Hardcore Gamer[/url], and [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2020/07/turn-based-adventure-game-echo-generation-announced-for-xbox-series-x-xbox-one-and-pc]Gematsu[/url].

Don't forget to add [i]Echo Generation[/i] to your Wishlist here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1072300/Echo_Generation]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1072300/Echo_Generation[/url]

:poterobot: Team Cococucumber

notes.title: Patch 1.2 & OSX Release Notes
notes.content:
[img]http://i.giphy.com/3oEdv9UKALp1NHpL32.gif[/img]

Hello players! This patch is a special one for us as it falls on the same day as the Planet of the Eyes OSX release. 

That’s right folks, the game is now available for Mac players and we encourage you to tell your friends. Here’s a [url=https://twitter.com/cococucumberco/status/664533864786894848] tweet[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlanetoftheEyes/posts/462309723957246]facebook post[/url] for you to share.

Onward to the notes!

[h1]Changes (Windows & Mac):[/h1]
-Now using Steam Cloud for save games.
-Support for new screen aspect ratios, not limited to only 16:9 or 16:10. Options available in the Settings menu.
-Added a Mute button for the in-game audio, accessible through the Settings menu. 
-Added a Mute button for the in-game sound effects, accessible through the Settings menu.
-Fixed Z fighting asset issues in the Spaceship Crash level.

[h1]Notes (Mac specific):[/h1]
-Please check the Minimum System Requirements for your Mac on the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/350970]Store Page[/url] to see if the game is compatible with your laptop or computer. 
-Controller / gamepad support not working for Xbox One. Support controllers are Xbox 360, PS3 and PS4. Please check that you’ve installed the latest drivers.

[h1] Known Issues (Mac specific):[/h1]
-When accessing the Steam Community in game (Shift-Tab) there may be graphics rendering issues on certain assets, showed in pink or grey. 
-When using the F12 button in game to take a screenshot there may be graphics rendering issues showed in pink or grey for 3-4 seconds. This will return to normal after that and does not affect gameplay.


Don’t forget to follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlanetoftheEyes]Facebook[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/cococucumberco]Twitter[/url] for more updates on Planet of the Eyes news, swag and more.

Thanks for reading!  <3
-Cococucumber

notes.title: Release Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[img]http://i.giphy.com/l41m0Qerhca3rMndK.gif [/img]

Since the rigorous 4-day non-stop testing at PAX and watching all the Let's Plays of Planet of the Eyes, we've decided to power through the list of bugs and changes. 

Reminder that if you're using an Xbox One controller and Windows 10, please make sure you have updated drivers or the controller won't function properly (robot will keep running in one direction). The fix for that is [url=steamcommunity.com/games/350970/announcements/detail/83668697] here[/url].


[h1]Bug Fixes: [/h1]
-Fixed the offset on the robot animated mesh from the control rig after many play-throughs.
-Fixes issue of timer countdown not resetting for Scrapper attack position B when re-entering the switch.
-Fixed issue of Scrapper stuck in a shocked state on respawn if the robot suicides on it after pulling back the crate.
-Fixed animation glitch when pushing rotating objects.
-Fixed the double egg scenario after removing the hanging egg in the Water pipes level.
-Fixed issue when after finishing the game, if you replay from the start the credit loop sound comes back.


[h1]Changes: [/h1]
-Made it easier to jump over the Scrapper switch.
-Scrapper stays on attack position B for an extra second longer.
-The door in the temple is now open upon replay.
-Prevent robot from climbing ledges if an object is directly above its head. 
-Change Steam lava achievement to only occur in Lava level.
-Fixed issue of robot walking into a moving platform if jumping near a ledge as it goes up.
-Made a previous audiolog stop before new audiolog starts to play. 
-Remove floating trees in the Scrapper level.
-Fixed issue of robot's head intersecting with the metal crate in Scrapper level.
-Patch over the ceiling in the Observatory level where the gap for the old laser used to be.
-Change the texture colour of lasers to match lighting.
-Add to pull/push functionality on both sides for gas tanks.
-Add Shift/Alt/Option key on the right side of the keyboard to grab objects. 


Thanks for reading!  <3
-Cococucumber

notes.title: FIX: Xbox One controller and Windows 10 compatibility issue
notes.content:
We’ve had some reports of the Xbox One controller not working correctly in Planet of the Eyes. The robot will keep running left when the Xbox One controller is plugged in. 

This seems to be an issue with the Xbox One controller, Windows 10 and an old driver, so here is a fix involving uninstalling and reinstalling the driver. 

[b]Instructions:[/b]
- Plug in your Xbox One controller.
- Download the driver from http://support.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-one/accessories/controller-pc-compatibility
- Run the driver installer.
- If there is an option to de-install (Remove) the current driver, please do so. If not, install the driver with the Xbox One controller still plugged in.
- The Xbox One controller should start to rumble. If it does not, please repeat the last two steps again: Remove the current driver and Install the new driver.


Thanks to zolointo for troubleshooting this issue. 

Also, please read http://steamcommunity.com/app/261570/discussions/0/530646080866733155/ for a similar reported issue.

Thanks!
-Cococucumber
